reason: $89 a month is more than a tenth of what I earn in a month, and my Excel costs me nothing and I know it by heart. I would not move my clients and debts for that money.
objection: Too expensive for my shop, and I would have to move all my clients and retrain my staff. Only 1 to 5 companies pay and nobody I know uses it, so who do I ask?
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 to $20 a month, plus a friend who runs a shop telling me he uses it and that it saved him time. Also if they moved my Excel list in for me.
